description: pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs:332-341 — build_path loops over max_depth 1..=MAX_DEPTH. If dfs() returns Err(BudgetExceeded) in any round (via the ? operator), the entire build_path returns BudgetExceeded immediately. This means a pool with >10,000 non-matching candidates at depth 1 will trigger BudgetExceeded before any depth-2 or deeper paths are tried, even if a valid 2-hop path exists. A legitimate pool with a large number of irrelevant CAs (e.g. a browser root store mixed with intermediates) could exceed the budget at shallow depths. Fix options: (1) continue to the next round on BudgetExceeded (treating budget-exceeded at depth k as 'no path at depth k'), or (2) document that BudgetExceeded means 'pool too large for any depth' rather than 'pool too large for this depth'.
title: build_path BudgetExceeded in early round prevents later valid-depth discovery
